Name: Clear Glasses - HD Graphics Depixelation and Filters
Author: aurpine
Description:
[size=3]Tired of low dimension pixel graphics? This mod scales up the sprites while loading to deliver you a performant and HD experience. This mod builds upon the open source [url=https://github.com/ameisen/SV-SpriteMaster]SpriteMaster[/url] project, but more! In addition to supporting Stardew 1.6, the mod comes with colour filters. This means you can efficiently change the look of your game beyond just the lines - but also colour!

Translations are included in the mod natively. Feel free to contribute better translations as they are currently auto-generated.

Note: the main pathfinding optimization has been added to Stardew 1.6 so this mod does not help performance as much anymore. Additionally, some of the visual performance fixes are currently broken. This mod is not recommended if you are looking for purely performance.[/size]

[size=4][b]Settings[/b][/size]
[size=3][url=https://imgur.com/a/c9fuyop]Video overview[/url]

You can easily change your settings when [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is also installed. Otherwise, you can access the advanced settings in the config.toml file that is generated after the game is run once with the mod installed.

Five scalers are supported
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]xBRZ [/b](default)[/size]
[*][size=3]EPX w/ ScaleX[/size]
[*][size=3]EPX (Legacy)[/size]
[*][size=3]xBREPX[/size]
[*][size=3]None (Vanilla textures with filters)[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/21090/21090-1723794341-226186219.png[/img]

[/size][size=3]Filters
[list]
[*][size=3]Saturation[/size]
[*][size=3]Brightness[/size]
[*][size=3]Temperature (blue or red)[/size]
[/list][/size]Only saturation is enabled by default with a value of -20.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/21090/21090-1723791496-516972748.png[/img]
